active_player.limits: Same-build opt-in deny/Grab/native carry/Drop exercise and explicit missing-smoke rejection only; the Player checks its typed host traces and shape-relative fall bound. External validation checks the declared marker measurements and unchanged passive-smoke lifetime/zero-reference teardown. No combined-map traversal, ordinary player input, feel, art, multiplayer, FPS or gate acceptance; independent review NotRun.

api_compile.limits: API compilation only, with no new Unity import, package resolution, test execution, serialization, physics, Player or gate acceptance. Existing native-context package pins may be inspected; no fresh native graph, Unity-generated symbols or platform variants are claimed.

combined_map.limits: Source declarations and native collision/anchor preparation only; not PlayMode, Player, route traversal, ladder operation, room art, materials, lighting, feel, multiplayer, FPS or gate acceptance. The combined-map export is unreviewed and its dirty export revision is provenance, not approval. Explicit preinitialized SDK Library/PackageCache seed; NOT fresh cold package extraction. Only package-cache files are reused; no seed Assets, Packages, ProjectSettings, other Library folders, ScriptAssemblies or first-party compiled code are copied. First-party and SDK compilation, strict initialization/clean preparation, declared tests, requested builds/Players and audits belong to the unchanged selected runner. No retry, UPM override, diagnostic relaxation, independent review or gate acceptance.
